metadata.title: BioDCASE 2026 Task 4: ATBFL Dataset
metadata.description:
General Description

This directory contains the development data for Task 4 of BioDCASE 2026 challenge. This is a curated subset of the ATBFL (Acoustic Trends Blue Fin Library).
 
Overview:
  • 15,633 audio file entries (corresponding to ~21.7 hours) with corresponding pre-computed embeddings
  • Derived from ATBFL (one of the largest annotated datasets in marine bioacoustics, gathering underwater recordings around Antarctica from 2005 to 2017)
  • Recordings from 11 different deployments organized as site-year datasets (e.g., kerguelen-2015, casey2014)
  • Each sample can contain multiple overlapping whale call types: bma, bmb, bmz, bmd, bpd, bp20, bp20plus

Folder Structure

ATBFL_BASEAL_Data/
   └── labels.csv # Main annotation file
   └── metadata.csv # Metadata file (recording location, annotator, etc.)
   └── embeddings/
        └── perch_v2/ (.npy pre-computed embeddings from Perch v2 model)

Class Distribution

Class Description Count
bma

ABZ Call (Blue Whale)

Constant-frequency tone between 25–28 Hz, no additional units

 10,356
bmb

ABZ Call Variant (Blue Whale)

Similar to BmA but followed by partial/full inter-tone downsweep

 7,240
bmz

ABZ Call with Z-Shape (Blue Whale)

Two tonal units (A and C), often with B downsweep between them, forming "Z" shape

 5,432
bmd

Downsweep (Blue Whale)

Downsweep with continuous frequency modulation

 4,065
bp20

Bp Call (Fin Whale)

Pulsed calls with peak energy at 20 Hz

 3,582
bp20plus

Bp Call With Higher Freq. Energy (Fin Whale)

Similar to Bp20 with additional energy at 80–100 Hz

 2,414
bpd

Downsweep (Fin Whale)

Downsweep with continuous frequency modulation

 2,312
